text: Sylvester's law of inertia says that for a real symmetric bilinear form, which datum is independent of the diagonalizing basis?
choices: The signature — the counts (p, q, r) of +1, −1, and 0 diagonal entries
The eigenvalues of its Gram matrix
The determinant of its Gram matrix
explanation: Any two diagonalizations with entries in {+1, −1, 0} have the same counts of each sign — that triple is the complete congruence invariant. The Gram matrix itself transforms as M ↦ PᵀMP, so its eigenvalues and determinant do change (det by the positive factor det(P)²).
